A '''Gathering''', one of the [[Gathering/Legends|main rituals]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was held in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] for a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] consisting of [[Byph/Legends|Byph]], [[Ganodi/Legends|Ganodi]], [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]], [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], [[Petro/Legends|Petro]], and [[Zatt/Legends|Zatt]].
